hypotheses.failureCondition: Reject at the predeclared ten-observation futility screen if fewer than two consecutive eligible observations satisfy both entry rules, or if the route cannot produce valid quotes for the required exact sizes. A passing screen is not acceptance or profit. Retain the original control and require the seven-day/1,000-observation acceptance gate; unknown extra gas, infrastructure, and model invoice costs preclude a full-profit claim.
hypotheses.name: wPONS-mediated four-hop size-curve probe
hypotheses.rationale: Hypothesis needing fresh quotes: the WETH → wPONS → PONS → USDG → WETH route may have a size-dependent after-gas net that is not represented by the rejected prior route/size cells. Quote every supplied exact size up to 0.005 WETH and select the greatest current after-gas net; do not scale quote outputs. Entry requires the selected quote to meet the 20 bps edge floor and cover the configured 15000 bps gas-safety requirement for two consecutive eligible observations. Training blocks 96049192 and 96066325 are examples of the forward observations recorded in the prior trials; they do not validate this new route or cell.

hypotheses.failureCondition: Reject at the predeclared ten-observation futility screen if fewer than two consecutive eligible observations meet the quote-improvement and gas-safety rules, or if the route lacks valid exact-size quotes. A passing screen is not acceptance or profit. Preserve the original control and require the seven-day/1,000-observation acceptance gate; unknown extra gas, infrastructure, and model invoice costs remain excluded from any full-profit claim.
hypotheses.name: wPONS triangle quote-improvement probe
hypotheses.rationale: Hypothesis needing fresh quotes: this WETH → PONS → wPONS → WETH triangle uses a different route and strategy family from the prior four-hop trials. It tests whether the same-size amount out sometimes improves by at least 100 bps over the previous consecutive source-valid quote while the current net edge still covers safety gas. The first source-valid row cannot signal. The training evidence records no candidate signals for the earlier trials at blocks 96049192 and 96066325; it gives no forward validation for this route or size.

limitations: The supplied training rows do not establish quotes for either selected route/size cell; fresh same-block control and candidate observations are required.
The pool graph reflects bounded recent discovery and exclusions, not complete chain coverage.
Quote opportunities do not establish fills, trades, inclusion, or earned returns.
No proposal changes live strategy policy; new strategy code, signing, and deployment are unavailable.
analysis.summary: The supplied cohort contains 52 observations and 312 quotes. The two prior wPONS-route trials were rejected with no candidate signals in their ten-observation screens; neither result validates a new forward test. The proposals below use different route IDs and are bounded paper experiments, not live strategy changes. The chosen cells are listed in the menu, but their exact-size quotes are not established here and require fresh observations. Preserve the original control and seven-day/1,000-observation acceptance gate; quote opportunities are not fills or earned returns.
